name: ragleap-security
summary: Small, auditable security primitives for the ragleap libraries: immutable tenant scopes, a tamper-evident hash-chained audit log, secret handling and redaction, hard input limits, rate limits, keys with rotation, file integrity manifests and optional authenticated encryption. Standard library only, except optional AES-256-GCM encryption (extra: crypto). Not independently audited.
author: RagLeap
